hypothesis: Template-aware objective anchors plus a substantive confirmed-read finish gate improve ContextBench final-source accuracy while reducing known model tokens and duration against native convergence across four fresh language/repository strata.
selection_rule: For each of the same four language/repository strata as G01 aggregate campaign r1, choose the first lexicographically later source-only task absent from prior local benchmark evidence and present in the pinned VPS repository cache; no gold labels inspected.
decision_rule: Run and report all four frozen tasks regardless of earlier outcomes. Seal each matched pair before pinned native scoring. An aggregate campaign pass requires all four pairs scoreable, candidate macro-mean Span-F1 and File-F1 both strictly above control, summed known model tokens and summed measured duration both strictly below control, and no more than one task with lower Span-F1. Report every task regression and validity failure; a later source or task change begins a new campaign.
claim_ceiling: Four-task cross-language G01 replication for the objective-anchor arm only; not full ContextBench or cross-benchmark ARE product proof.
